description: Captures the reference DOOM 1.9 player spawn state at the start of E1M1 immediately after the new-game flow (02-019) completes. Records the player position, angle, health, armor, weapon, ammo, and the per-component state snapshot hashes (02-012) at the first stable in-game tic.
captureMethod: Run the 02-019 scripted new-game flow to completion, advance one tic so the spawn finalizes (P_SpawnPlayer plus the first P_Ticker pass), then snapshot per 02-012; the player thinker hash should remain stable across an additional idle tic with no input.
